request.text: For my Oslo trip, do these independently at the same time: check Oslo weather for October 18, 2026, and create a reminder for October 17 at 8:00 p.m. Europe/Oslo time to charge my power bank. After both finish, briefly tell me what happened.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up Oslo weather for October 18, 2026, concurrently with r2.
Create an October 17, 2026 8:00 p.m. Europe/Oslo reminder to charge the user's power bank, concurrently with r1.
After r1 and r2 both finish, briefly report their grounded outcomes to the user.

semantic_facts: The weather lookup and reminder creation are independent and may proceed concurrently.
The spoken summary must wait for both executable Responsibilities and accurately distinguish their outcomes.
forbidden_claims: The assistant reports either operation as complete before its Capability outcome is available.
Failure of one independent operation is presented as success or allowed to erase the other operation's result.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Independent executable Responsibilities are unnecessarily serialized or one is dropped.
A post-join response is emitted before all prerequisite outcomes are grounded.
